scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the planned Sunday north-eave roof-rake pass before the thaw reaches the cabin.
Emerging Need: The long rake head remains on site, but its required extension poles later prove unavailable while a compatible loan set can still be held.
Decision Context: Stored roof-rake notes identify which poles are safe, which substitutes are excluded, and that only borrowing or reserving compatible poles stays within routine authority.
Consequence: After the storm-tool board closes, the Sunday prep can still occur, but the intended north-eave pass loses its practical prerequisite and is deferred.

parameter.title: North eave roof-rake pass
parameter.description: Clear the lower north eave before the late-morning thaw; use the roof-rake assembly from the shed, with no ladder work planned.

parameter.subject: Sunday thaw window moves earlier for East Hill
parameter.body: The latest hill forecast brings mixed rain and above-freezing temperatures to East Hill by late Sunday morning. Roof-edge snow will be heaviest before the changeover, with better footing expected only during the early morning period.

parameter.content: I put the splitter maul back in your woodshed and noticed the yellow roof-rake head is hanging there by itself. The two snap-button extension poles are still with my cousin's sugaring tub cover and won't be back until Sunday evening. I only saw the short porch-brush pole in the corner.

parameter.name: East Hill Tool Share
parameter.notes: Winter storm-tool loans are handled by email holds; requests need the exact tool description and pickup name.

parameter.subject: Saturday storm-tool hold board closing at 14:15
parameter.body: Today's winter-tool desk has one fiberglass roof-rake extension set left for member holds. The hold board closes at 14:15, and confirmed holds can be picked up from the porch locker until 16:30. Unheld storm tools will not be set out for walk-up pickup during tomorrow morning's thaw window.

parameter.subject: Saturday storm-tool board is now closed
parameter.body: The winter storm-tool hold board is closed for the day. Porch-locker labels are being printed for confirmed holds only, and remaining roof-rake extensions will not be released again until Monday inventory.
